thought.text: Now importing the 83MB data dump (this may take a minute):

reasoning_content:
Note: The guide says "create extension postgis;" — I used IF NOT EXISTS, but that's fine.

Next, restore the dump. The dump is 83MB in custom format. Since the dump's owner is probably postgres, I'll run it as the postgres user. I'll use pg_restore with -v --no-owner.

action.command: cd /workspace && chmod 644 sql/data && su - postgres -c "pg_restore --dbname=postgres --no-owner -v /workspace/sql/data" > /tmp/pg_restore.log 2>&1; echo "EXIT: $?"; tail -5 /tmp/pg_restore.log
